title: Locked design, transcribed from the original written plan
provenance: The author recorded the plan as written 2026-08-15 at 18:39 UTC-07:00. It entered version history with the results at 19:09:58 UTC-07:00. No pre-run copy survives, so that history cannot independently prove the claimed order. This transcription is not an earlier timestamp.

universe.qualification: at least 250 daily bars in each window

families.CHANNEL: close breaks above highest high of prior `sig` bars

friction.meaning: fraction of 1R paid per round trip

fair_null: per-ticker buy-and-hold over the same window; alpha = strategy net% - B&H net%
predictions: The in-sample optimum looks like an edge. For the median instance, best-of-16 IS alpha over buy-and-hold is positive and materially above the median knob's IS alpha.
THE KILL — the same knobs do not carry. For the median instance, the best-of-16 knobs' OOS alpha over buy-and-hold is ≤ 0, and the median instance's (OOS alpha − IS alpha) is strongly negative.
The surface is a spike, not a plateau. For the median instance the spike gap is large relative to the spread of the 16 cells, and fewer than half of the 16 knob settings beat buy-and-hold in-sample.
Best-of-N rises with N purely from the count. Mean best-of-N IS net increases monotonically in N, while the mean OOS net of the selected setting does not increase with N.
Friction bites. With `COST_R = 0.05` the median knob's IS net falls materially.
conditional_dispositions: If P2 AND P3 both fail — the surface is a broad plateau (most of the 16 beat B&H IS, small spike gap) *and* the best knobs' OOS alpha holds at or above zero for the median instance — then the registered thesis is falsified, and that is a *better* episode, not a dead one: the strategy has real structure and the knobs are cosmetic. The lesson flips to *"here is how you tell a fitted EA from a robust one — and here is one that passes."* Report it as the headline, in those words.

If P2 holds but P3 fails — a broad plateau that still dies out-of-sample — then the parameter surface is not the buyer-facing tell we thought it was, the "lone spike" beat is struck from the spine, and the held-out half carries the episode alone. Say so explicitly.

If P1 fails — the best-of-16 does not even look like an edge in-sample — the design is too weak to demonstrate anything and the result is inconclusive. Report it as inconclusive and do not narrate a verdict from it.
data: Daily prices, the delisted-name history and the ticker reference file used for the renames come from Massive.com (formerly Polygon.io), pulled once on 2026-06-22 and split-adjusted as of that pull. The supporting opening-range study used one-minute bars from the same vendor. EODHD, the market-data affiliate linked in the video description, did not supply these measurements.
separation: Cleaning, joined-history exclusions and open-position re-reading were later work. They are not part of this original locked design.
